title: Root-sparsity scaling for Hamiltonian simulation, differential equations and linear-system solvers
summary: We give quantum algorithms for Hamiltonian simulation, linear differential equations, and linear systems with square-root dependence on sparsity. For an $s$-sparse Hermitian matrix with row and column Euclidean norms bounded by $η$, evolution for time $t$ to error $ε$ uses $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{s}τ+\sqrt{sτ\log(1/ε)}+\log(1/ε))$ queries, where $τ=η|t|$. The same bound holds for time-dependent Hamiltonians with coherent time-indexed sparse access and certified time discretisation.
